data.question_intent: Inquire about the bank's willingness to repricing in the US Consumer Business and the number of UK branches.
data.question_quote: First one is on the US Consumer business, [specifically on the cards side]. You just have given us an update on how competitive that space is when [looking for partners] and then your new capabilities in the USCB, does that make you more willing [to push in terms of repricing]?
data.answer_quote: Okay, so let me just update on cards within USCB. So the environment is competitive but it has always been doing so, I wouldn't call it out as different. When we are competing for those partnerships, we are assuming that we go to our new capital level. So we are assuming an AIRB capital loading and that's the basis on which we would assess their financial delivery and we have hurdle rates that you would expect and we would expect new partners to meet those levels and we've clearly given a target of mid teens for this business.
data.reason: The answer directly addresses the question about repricing in the US Consumer Business and provides a specific target for the business, indicating a willingness to push in terms of repricing. It also answers the question about the number of UK branches by stating they are 'relatively modest' without giving a specific number.
